audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven chart rows disagreed with the packet chart, with the mirror, and with the whys printed on the same page.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Skill, Yone, Skill, Skill, Yone, Yone, Yone]; whys[0] says level 1 is a skill lane, whys[2] and whys[3] say skill-decided, whys[4] says you spike over her at 6 — all contradicted by the sides shown.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 2 and 3 -> Skill, rows 1 and 4 -> Yone, ratings moved with them, each as a matched full+content pair.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 phase text hedged about her ultimate instead of naming your own spike and its cost.
audit.why: Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s and Final Hour only grants invisibility during Tumble, not a general escape.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten with the 120s cost and what Final Hour actually hides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn was written as a flat 'wall-stun' with no cooldown and no statement that the stun requires terrain; Tumble's auto-attack reset was never given as the tell.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s and only impales into terrain; Tumble is 6/5/4/3/2s and resets her attack, so the wind-up is the cue, not the cast.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[0].text rewritten with the timers, the terrain condition and the reset tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Condemn's knockback displaces Yone's body or his spirit during Soul Unbound is unstated.
audit.why: Riot's text does not cover it and needsResearch is empty by design; the mirror left it unasserted too.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vayne's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fate Sealed's blink and pull answer her kiting, and it is 120s — spend it on the kill, not on chip. Final Hour hides her Tumble.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Condemn is 20s at rank 1 and stuns only into terrain. Fight in the open.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Condemn (E): 20s at rank 1 — it only stuns if a wall is behind you, so fight in open lane. - Tumble: 6s at rank 1, down to 2s at rank 5. - Soul Unbound (E): 22s at rank 1 — never spend it on chip.

edits.before: Vayne's Tumble (Q) resets and Silver Bolts (W) true-damage punish you if you sit still, but she's squishy and immobile off Q — close the gap with Q3 dash and she folds fast.
edits.after: Tumble (Q) is an auto reset — the wind-up is your cue to step out, not the cast. Silver Bolts (W) needs three hits on you; break the count, dash in on Q3, and she folds.

notes: packet suspectName 'Fate Sealed's' in late is a FALSE POSITIVE — Fate Sealed is Yone's real R. No edit made there.
